canonical_spec.title: Fixed income, derivatives and quantitative finance
canonical_spec.assessment: Price and hedge contingent claims, derive continuous-time results and explain model, credit and liquidity risk.
canonical_spec.project: Build a documented pricing-and-risk toolkit with bond valuation, curve construction, binomial options, Monte Carlo and hedge-error analysis.

shared_rules.exam_contract: Original distinct Forms A/B: five20-point domains,100 points,240-minute suggested uncalibrated design target. Complete worked determinate solutions, explicit subpart point allocation, proof hypotheses, open-answer rubrics. Each form maps all12 chapter outcomes. Supply necessary normal-CDF values or small tables for pencil-and-paper arithmetic; no unstated software access in a closed-resource section. No copied chapter problems or number-only reassessment. Coordinate blueprints before full drafting.

domains.D1: Cash-flow pricing, curve construction and rate exposure (c01–c03)
domains.D2: Credit, forwards/futures/swaps and dated collateral/funding cash (c04–c05)
domains.D3: Finite replication/stopping, Brownian/Ito and continuous valuation (c06–c08)
domains.D4: Greeks, volatility, financed hedging and numerical/sampling error (c09–c10)
domains.D5: Incomplete/exotic contract identification and controlled model use (c11–c12)

shared_rules.acceptance: All payloads independently recomputed, all prompts solved, methods already taught, explicit provenance/source scope, peer/coordinator audit before acceptance. Root alone assembles final v10.html and updates canonical/shared/hosting. No subagents, new installations or external messages.

assignments.scope: Form A uses coherent bond/curve/hedge and option-pricing cases across D1–D5, including a nonparallel or short-rate distinction, explicitly dated credit/funding, actual self-financing replication and Ito/PDE reasoning, numerical-error evidence, and a finite nonunique valuation/permission decision. Author chooses tractable original values and publishes blueprint before drafting; all12 chapters must have assessed evidence.

Form B is a structurally distinct reassessment across identical D1–D5 coverage: different cash timing/information set, alternative hedge/credit/equivalent-measure or early-exercise cases, discrete hedge/variance/conditioning diagnosis, and different incomplete/exotic/model-control evidence. Coordinate with A to avoid number-only variants; develop complete solutions and scoring.

Build an original coherent pricing-and-risk toolkit and model-use defense, beyond rerunning chapter labs. Required: dated bond cash/curve construction, rate shocks/hedge sensitivities, finite-tree options and exercise, independently anchored vanilla/Monte Carlo with declared sampling units/error, funded discrete-hedge error/transaction costs, and explicitly scoped credit/path/nonunique valuation or governance failure cases. Inputs and cash conventions must fit one fictional desk decision. Separate exact arithmetic, deterministic discretization, ideal sampling uncertainty and model/contract uncertainty; do not let code correctness approve all uses. Supply bounded standard-library model, full synthetic inputs/provenance/output/manifest/README, independent numerical/intervention checker, complete instructor guide,100-point rubric and essential-domain floors, required learner report/code/evidence/limitations, and new transfer tasks. Send architecture and numeric anchors to root before full prose.

root_scope: Prerequisite diagnostic and complete answers; administration, coverage/domain map, thresholds and critical-error rules; oral transfer/teach-back; distinct delayed retention with solutions and remediation; notation/concept index linked to actual chapter anchors; volume synthesis and honest limitations. Integrate all components, root independent numerical/proof/prompt audit, structural/full regression/offline checks and private publication.
